title: Let the Guru's word rein the mind
summary: The Guru's word reins the mind into right order. Return the hand to trust before it closes again.
takeaway: Return the hand to trust before it closes again.
lifeApplication: Before you enter the meeting or answer the message, ask what is holding your mind right now. Choose one line of Shabad before image or cleverness takes the lead.

source.shortMeaning: The Guru's word reins the mind into right order.
